description: This file defines a PHP interface named HomePageEnablerInterface within the OrangeHRM Core HomePage namespace. The interface declares a method isEnabled that determines whether a given User object is enabled for the homepage functionalities.

classes.name: HomePageEnablerInterface
classes.description: An interface that defines the contract for enabling or disabling the homepage features for a user.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the given User is enabled for the homepage. Returns a boolean.
